findings.issue: Task 8 Acceptance Criteria note: 'T1 может использовать caplog (pytest-style) вместо assertLogs (unittest-style) — оба валидны'. However the tech-spec says the base class is _FallbackPublishPathsCase(unittest.TestCase) at line 90 — a unittest.TestCase subclass. In unittest.TestCase, `assertLogs` is the standard method; `caplog` is a pytest fixture not automatically available to unittest.TestCase subclasses without explicit pytest configuration. The edge-case note may mislead the auditor into accepting a caplog-based assertion that won't work correctly in a unittest.TestCase context without pytest-specific setup. This is a minor precision issue — caplog can work with unittest.TestCase if the test method accepts it as a parameter via pytest injection, but it's unusual.
findings.fix: Clarify: 'If the test class inherits unittest.TestCase (as _FallbackPublishPathsCase does), assertLogs is the expected mechanism. caplog is acceptable only if the test method explicitly receives it as a pytest fixture parameter — verify the method signature.' Add: 'In this codebase caplog is not used in existing _FallbackPublishPathsCase tests; assertLogs is the established pattern.'
